# FORME PILATES

> Boutique reformer and mat Pilates studio in Singapore, offering beginner-friendly classes for women in a calm, monochrome studio space.

FORME PILATES is a women-led, women-focused Pilates studio on Orchard Road, Singapore (3-minute walk from Somerset MRT, Orchard Road exit). Rated 4.9★ on Google Reviews and trusted by 2,000+ women across Singapore. Classes are capped at 8 people per session.

## Classes

- **Reformer Pilates** — full-body reformer Pilates classes for all levels; the studio's signature class.
- **Mat Pilates** — classical core-focused mat work, ideal for beginners and lunchtime sessions.
- **Prenatal & Postnatal Pilates** — safe, supportive classes for every stage of motherhood, led by certified instructors.
- **Private Sessions** — one-on-one, fully tailored sessions for injury recovery, milestones, or accelerating progress.

Classes run Monday–Saturday, 6:45am–7:15pm (early morning, lunchtime express, evening, and weekend slots). Closed Sundays.

## Pricing

- Intro class: $19 SGD (usual $45), includes a complimentary First-Timer's Guide. Limited to 20 intro spots per month.
- Ongoing: single drop-ins and 5/10/20-class packages at member rates.
- Payment: PayNow, major credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay.

## Location & contact

## Frequently asked questions

- New to Pilates? Beginners are welcome at every reformer class — instructors guide first-timers through modifications, no experience needed.
- What to wear: fitted activewear and grippy (non-slip) socks (available for purchase at the studio).
- Payment: PayNow, credit cards, and Apple/Google Pay accepted; class packages available after the intro class.
- Pregnant or recovering from injury? Prenatal/Postnatal classes and private sessions are available with instructors trained in safe modifications; consult a doctor before starting.
